import flask
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, g
import subprocess
import os
import tempfile
import hashlib
import hmac

app = Flask(__name__)

# Configuration
REPORT_DIR = os.environ.get('REPORT_DIR', '/tmp/reports')
ALLOWED_FORMATS = ['pdf', 'csv', 'html']
SIGNING_KEY = os.environ.get('HMAC_KEY', 'default-dev-key')

def verify_request_signature(payload, signature):
    """Verify HMAC signature of request body"""
    expected = hmac.new(SIGNING_KEY.encode(), payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature)

@app.before_request
def check_internal_header():
    """Middleware: verify requests come from internal service mesh"""
    # In production, the service mesh sidecar sets x-mesh-authenticated
    if os.environ.get('REQUIRE_MESH_AUTH') == 'true':
        if request.headers.get('x-mesh-authenticated') != 'true':
            return jsonify({'error': 'unauthorized'}), 403

@app.route('/api/v1/reports/generate', methods=['POST'])
def generate_report():
    """Generate a report in the specified format.
    
    Accepts JSON body with:
      - template: name of the report template
      - output_format: one of pdf, csv, html
      - filters: dict of filter parameters
      - title: report title (used in filename)
    """
    data = request.get_json(force=True)
    
    template = data.get('template', 'default')
    output_format = data.get('output_format', 'pdf')
    filters = data.get('filters', {})
    title = data.get('title', 'report')
    
    # Validate format
    if output_format not in ALLOWED_FORMATS:
        return jsonify({'error': f'Invalid format. Allowed: {ALLOWED_FORMATS}'}), 400
    
    # Validate template exists
    template_path = os.path.join('/app/templates', f'{template}.jinja2')
    if not os.path.isfile(template_path):
        return jsonify({'error': 'Template not found'}), 404
    
    # Build the report generation command
    # Using wkhtmltopdf for PDF, or custom converters for other formats
    output_filename = f"{title}_{hashlib.md5(str(filters).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}.{output_format}"
    output_path = os.path.join(REPORT_DIR, output_filename)
    
    # Render template to HTML first
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', suffix='.html', delete=False) as tmp:
        from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader
        env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader('/app/templates'))
        tmpl = env.get_template(f'{template}.jinja2')
        rendered = tmpl.render(filters=filters, title=title)
        tmp.write(rendered)
        tmp_path = tmp.name
    
    if output_format == 'pdf':
        cmd = f"wkhtmltopdf {tmp_path} {output_path}"
    elif output_format == 'csv':
        cmd = f"python3 /app/converters/html2csv.py {tmp_path} {output_path}"
    else:
        cmd = f"cp {tmp_path} {output_path}"
    
    # Execute conversion
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            shell=True,
            capture_output=True,
            timeout=30,
            cwd=REPORT_DIR
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            app.logger.error(f"Conversion failed: {result.stderr.decode()}")
            return jsonify({'error': 'Conversion failed'}), 500
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Report generation timed out'}), 504
    finally:
        os.unlink(tmp_path)
    
    return jsonify({
        'status': 'success',
        'report_url': f'/reports/{output_filename}',
        'size_bytes': os.path.getsize(output_path)
    })

@app.route('/api/v1/reports/batch', methods=['POST'])
def batch_reports():
    """Generate multiple reports. Accepts array of report specs."""
    specs = request.get_json(force=True)
    if not isinstance(specs, list) or len(specs) > 10:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Expected array of max 10 specs'}), 400
    
    results = []
    for spec in specs:
        # Reuse single report logic
        with app.test_request_context(
            '/api/v1/reports/generate',
            method='POST',
            json=spec
        ):
            resp = generate_report()
            results.append(resp[0].get_json() if isinstance(resp, tuple) else resp.get_json())
    
    return jsonify({'results': results})

@app.route('/health', methods=['GET'])
def health():
    return jsonify({'status': 'ok', 'version': '2.4.1'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    os.makedirs(REPORT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080)
